name: silent-hill-1-remake-2027-report
note: تقرير: MP1st (26 Oct 19:13Z, exclusive) says Bloober Team's Silent Hill 1 remake, casting codename Project Noise, targets 2027 and names two actresses; Konami has announced no date (remake announced June 2025). Stand-in footage: Konami's official Silent Hill 2 remake trailers (Steam 2124490), credited on screen; no knife scene, no gore. Sound: release trailer's word-free score stretch 48.0 to 70.5 s. v2: the runner's Steam HLS copies started at other offsets, so v1 landed on title cards; v2 pins the judged files under live/ (launch 15-37 s, release 11-70 s, re-encoded crf 16, decode clean), times shifted.
